audience: retailers that use Tillhub for point-of-sale sales, stock and customer records

useCases.title: Review sales across branches
useCases.text: Read revenue totals and transaction reports for a period, then inspect the transactions behind the figures.

useCases.title: Find best-selling products
useCases.text: Identify top products for a period and inspect their catalog details, prices and taxes.

useCases.title: Check stock and recent movements
useCases.text: Read stock levels by product or location and trace sales, deliveries, corrections and transfers in the stock book.

useCases.title: Find a customer record
useCases.text: Search customers by name or email and inspect the selected customer’s contact details.

useCases.title: Inspect cash-register closings
useCases.text: Find cash-register closing balances by branch, register or staff member and review the recorded totals.
